notes.title: Lyonesse updated with new translations!
notes.content:
Lyonesse has been updated with full Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese translations. This concludes out first round of translations for Lyonesse.

We are very happy that Lyonesse is now available to play in these Languages:

English
German
Spanish
Brazilian-Portuguese
Portuguese
Korean
Japanese
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese

If you already own Lyonesse, these languages can be chosen from the Options Menu.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Lyonesse updated with German, Spanish and Portuguese Translation!
notes.content:
Lyonesse has been updated with full German, Spanish and Portuguese translations.

If you already own Lyonesse these languages can be chosen from the Options Menu.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Lyonesse is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h2]Come and taste the Fruits of Succulence[/h2]
We are super excited to announce that [i]Lyonesse [/i]is now available on Steam. Come and explore the mythical land for yourself!

[b]Thank you![/b]
Thank you to everyone who helped play-test Lyonesse and to all those that helped with its development.

[b]Lyonesse's Future[/b]
-Translating the game into more langauges
-Porting the game to MAC

[b]Fixing any bugs that appear in Lyonesse[/b]
 -Please let us know at rabbitholegames.contact@gmail.com if you encounter any problems with Lyonesse while playing :)

We really hope everyone enjoys their experience of playing Lyonesse!

Sincerely,
Rabbit Hole Games :)
